content.text: From: DHSCAssessment date: 16/07/2026Type: Alpha AssessmentResult: GreenService provider: NHSBSA
Service description
Through the services it delivers the NHSBSA generates a wealth of valuable data which is used to shape operational delivery, inform policy and provide public value.

People currently navigate multiple separate systems, with inconsistent experiences, to achieve these goals. This service is being designed to meet user needs, with a consistent user experience and a modular, technology-agnostic architecture to support future needs.

The NHSBSA Data Hub will give users a single place to discover, understand and access NHSBSA data products and services. The MVP has a narrower scope focus on data domains for prescribing and dispensing, ophthalmic and dental data.
